title: UltimateShulker
description: Open Shulker Boxes instantly from your hand! A lightweight, fully configurable, and exploit-free solution for modern survival servers.
body:
📦 UltimateShulker

Enhance your server's Quality of Life with the most secure and efficient portable Shulker Box plugin

**UltimateShulker** allows players to open Shulker Boxes directly from their inventory by simply right-clicking. No more placing, opening, breaking, and picking up! Designed for modern Survival, SMP, and Lifesteal servers

Key Features

⚡ Instant Access: Open Shulker Boxes instantly in the air
✋ Dual Hand Support: Works seamlessly in both Main Hand and Off-Hand
🛡️ Exploit & Dupe Protection:
Prevents placing a Shulker inside another Shulker (Nesting Protection)
Prevents dropping the item while the inventory is open
Prevents swapping hands during use
🎨 Fully Configurable: Customize all chat messages, sounds, and interaction rules
🔊 Immersive Sounds: Plays vanilla shulker sounds on open/close (customizable)
🚀 High Performance: Lightweight code optimized for Paper and Spigot

⚙️ Configuration
You have full control over the plugin via `config.yml`. You can change messages, sounds, and toggle security settings

🔒 Commands & Permissions
Commands
/shulkerreload

Description: Reloads the configuration file.
Permission: ultimateshulker.reload (Default: OP)
Permissions
ultimateshulker.use
Description: Allows opening shulker boxes in hand.
Default: True (Everyone has it by default)

💻 Compatibility
Versions: 1.16.5, 1.17, 1.18, 1.19, 1.20+
Software: Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Pufferfish
